capabilities: Roll initiative for creatures and sort the order
Advance the turn and count rounds
Track HP, AC and conditions per combatant
Read HP, AC and Dex from Fantasy Statblocks creature notes
Write every change back into the note as plain text
extras: Shows one static ad inside the tracker: the Players button, which promotes the maker's paid DM Screen and can be turned off in settings. A browser demo runs the plugin over a sample note. Creatures kept only in Fantasy Statblocks' own bestiary are not read; their hp and ac must be written on the line.
motivation: The fight is kept as plain text so it syncs, survives restarts, and still reads fine if the plugin is uninstalled.
problem: Running a fight in Obsidian means keeping turn order, hit points and conditions somewhere outside the note, where they do not sync or survive a restart.

relations.evidence: Quick Initiative reads the frontmatter that Fantasy Statblocks uses
With it installed, fights log themselves: when they start, each round, every hit
plan fights against the 5E XP budget, then start them in Quick Initiative
With DM Screen installed, the Players button in the tracker starts sharing

summary: Initiative tracker that keeps a whole combat as plain text in a note, rolling initiative, advancing turns and tracking HP, AC and conditions.
